claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Stage 27C class-local head covers remain valid, but this contiguous within-head slice decomposition did not recover held-out hard-partner readout margins under the preregistered controls.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: Within the Stage 27C per-class Pythia-160M attention-head covers, smaller contiguous within-head slices recover held-out hard-partner readout margins above matched random slice controls.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact neurons, complete circuits, MLP-neuron localization, raw CAS-symbol understanding, an internal CAS compiler, Noetic/40-Element component causality, free-form generation control, or cross-model component generality from Stage 27D.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27D is bounded to contiguous slices of the pre-output-projection attention-head vectors inside the Pythia-160M Stage 27C Foundation covers. It is not exact neuron discovery, an MLP-neuron claim, a complete circuit, token sonar, Noetic/40-Element coverage, raw CAS-symbol understanding, or generation control.

formal_anchor: Refined local-cover framing: Stage 26/27A gives a global head cover, Stage 27C gives class-indexed subcovers, and Stage 27D tests whether each class-indexed cover admits a smaller within-head subcover.

gates.criterion: Stage 7 activation artifact hash matches the locked manifest.
gates.name: artifact_contract

gates.criterion: Stage 27C source report is PASS, uses the locked artifact, and exposes per-class covers over the selected six-head family.
gates.name: stage27c_contract

gates.criterion: Slice-cover learning rows come only from train split; scoring rows come only from test split.
gates.name: learn_eval_separation

gates.criterion: Per-class slice covers beat per-row random same-size slice-cover mean margin on at least 60% of eval rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: matched_random_slice_control

gates.criterion: At least 55% of eval rows have positive target-vs-hard-partner margin under the per-class slice cover.
gates.name: positive_margin_floor

gates.criterion: Mean slice-cover gain is at least 25% of the mean Stage 27C class-head-cover gain.
gates.name: head_cover_gain_fraction

gates.criterion: Report slice-cover margin as a fraction of the full Stage 27C class-head cover margin; this is diagnostic, not required for PASS.
gates.name: head_cover_ceiling

method: Commit this pre-registration and runner before any Stage 27D GPU result is generated.
Refit the locked Stage 7 28-way Foundation probe on the locked layer-6 focus-token artifact.
Verify Stage 27C is PASS and was built from a locked Stage 7 artifact plus the Stage 26/27A six-head family.
Use Stage 27C per-class three-head covers as the candidate head set for each Foundation class.
Split each candidate head's 64-dimensional pre-output-projection slice into eight contiguous 8-dimensional slices.
Build a balanced slice-learning subset from Stage 7 train rows and a disjoint balanced evaluation subset from Stage 7 test rows.
For each learning row, globally ablate the six selected heads, then patch each candidate slice individually.
Score each candidate slice by target-vs-hard-partner Foundation probe-logit margin lift over the globally ablated state.
For each Foundation class, define an eight-slice class-local cover as the top slices by mean lift on learn rows for that class.
On held-out evaluation rows, compare class-local slice covers against same-size random slice covers sampled from the same class candidate heads.
Report the full Stage 27C class-head cover as the ceiling for each row; it is diagnostic, not the primary control.
motivation: Stage 27C found that hard-partner fineness lives in class-local attention-head covers. Stage 27D asks whether those class-local covers can be narrowed further to contiguous within-head vector slices without claiming literal neurons.
